blind.description: A stylized medieval/fantasy modular wall section constructed with a dark brown timber frame and off-white plaster infill. The upper portion features a large multi-pane window with a 4x3 wooden grid of translucent cream-yellow panes. Beneath the window sits a protruding wooden counter/ledge supported by decorative timber brackets on both sides, resting above two lower plaster panels divided by a central vertical timber post. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A thick horizontal brown bar with rounded ends, showing the window ledge/sill projecting symmetrically outward from both front and back faces in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in scale marker) and about 4 feet wide.
